title: 第786章 无比地针对第785章 根本站立不住
slug: 别人听劝仿明星你开局扮神明
content_zh:
，，！
毫无疑问，远方战场上的波动极为强悍。
而且极为针对，越强的人进入其中，遭受的反噬就越大。
就好像传说中的诅咒一般，就是在阻止他们前进。
诸天星斗大阵凝聚出的第二道身影在那里揭示。
这是上苍降下的诅咒。
无比地针对。
实在太强了，没有任何人敢在这一刻进入其中。
诸天星斗大阵凝聚出的第二道身影也是如此。
倒不如说，如果他进入，受到的反噬力量会更加强大。
情况只会更加糟糕。
「这么说，诸天星斗大阵凝聚出的那道身影刚刚独自出击、独自厮杀，就是因为这个原因？」「这个地方，在这里出手的，就只能有一个人？这就是我们天庭所要付出的代价？」有人颤抖着问道。
「不错，确实如此。
」诸天星斗大阵凝聚出的第二道身影冷静地点了点头。
先前的时候，周天星斗大阵实际上连续凝聚出了一道又一道人影。
但到最后只有第一道身影朝前迈步，其他的所有人影都是用神通法术在远处消耗，并没有真正出手。
并没有真正进攻，不敢正面触碰那片战场。
「我相信诸天星斗大阵凝聚出的那道身影终究会胜利的。
」「古往今来，我们经历过多少魔难，经历过多少战争，这只不过是区区九牛一毛而已，而且那里的只不过是一滴鲜血，焚烧殆尽之后，便是一切都结束的时刻。
」远处有一位天庭的神仙，这样说道。

一道又一道流光在天地之间回旋……上方的战斗依旧在持续。
所有的天兵天将们，都望着远方发生的一切，心中震撼无比。
他们都相信周天星斗大阵凝聚出的那道身影是无敌的！
然而他们的话语刚刚落下。
远方的周天星斗大阵凝聚出的那道身影便再次受到了重创！
那口古老的长剑，带着毁灭一切的波动，实在太过于可怕了。
长剑锋利无比，直接就划破了他的肌肤！
在他的脖子那里留下了一道深深的痕迹！
这道痕迹深刻见骨，差点就直接被嬴政在此地斩首了！
一片又一片古老的纹路，从那伤口之间涌进去，爆发出极为强大的波动，再次掀起了一阵波澜！
这些波动，擦着他的脖子，险之又险地横扫了过去！
看到这一幕，饶是周天星斗大阵凝聚出的那道身影近乎无敌，此刻也有些受不住了！
他在这里疯狂后退、疯狂撤退，想要暂避锋芒！
「休想如此，周天星斗大阵凝聚出的那道身影！
拿命来！
」远方的高空之上，嬴政长啸一声，身边光芒流转！
一片又一片光芒，照亮了这片天地之间！
没有什么能与他相提并论，没有什么能与他争锋！
content_en:
,,!
There is no doubt that the fluctuations on the distant battlefield are extremely powerful.
And it is extremely targeted. The stronger the person who enters it, the greater the backlash they will suffer.
It was like a legendary curse that was preventing them from moving forward.
The second figure condensed from the star formation in the sky was revealed there.
This is a curse from God.
Extremely targeted.
It is so strong that no one dares to enter it at this moment.
The same is true for the second figure condensed from the star formation in the sky.
Rather, if he enters, the backlash he receives will be even stronger.
The situation will only get worse.
"So, that's why the figure condensed from the star formation in the sky just attacked and fought alone?" "In this place, only one person can take action here? Is this the price we have to pay in heaven?" Someone asked tremblingly.
"Yes, indeed.
” The second figure condensed from the star formation in the sky nodded calmly.
Previously, the Zhoutian Xingdou Formation actually condensed one silhouette after another.
But in the end, only the first figure stepped forward, and all the other figures used magical powers to consume them in the distance without actually taking action.
There was no real attack, and they did not dare to touch the battlefield head-on.
"I believe that the figure condensed by the stars in the sky will eventually win.
"Throughout the ages, we have experienced so many tribulations and wars. This is just a drop in the bucket, and what is there is just a drop of blood. After it is burned away, it will be the end of everything."
"There was a god from heaven in the distance, saying this.
Stream after stream of light swirled between heaven and earth... The battle above continued.
All the heavenly soldiers and generals looked at what was happening in the distance, and their hearts were extremely shocked.
They all believe that the figure condensed by the Zhoutian Xingdou Formation is invincible!
However, their words had just fallen.
The figure condensed by the Zhoutian Starry Formation in the distance was hit hard again!
That ancient long sword, with its waves that destroyed everything, was really too terrifying.
The sword was so sharp that it directly cut through his skin!
There was a deep mark left on his neck!
This mark was so profound that Ying Zheng was almost beheaded right here!
Pieces after pieces of ancient lines poured in from between the wounds, erupting into extremely powerful fluctuations, causing another wave!
These fluctuations brushed against his neck and swept past him dangerously!
Seeing this scene, even though the figure condensed by the Zhoutian Xingdou Formation is almost invincible, I can't stand it anymore!
He retreated crazily here, trying to avoid the edge temporarily!
"Don't even think about it, that figure condensed by Zhoutian's star formation!
Take your life!
"High in the sky in the distance, Ying Zheng roared, and light flowed around him!
One after another, the light illuminates the space between heaven and earth!
Nothing can compare with him, nothing can compete with him!
